newsitem.title: USA: Jones Medical buys two drug treatments.
newsitem.headline: Jones Medical buys two drug treatments.

text.p: Jones Medical Industries Inc said it acquired Cytomel (liothyronine sodium tablets) and Triostat (liothyronine sodium injection) from SmithKline Beecham for $22.8 million.
Cytomel is a T3 thyroid replacement hormone used to treat various chronic thyroid disorders. Triostat is an injectable form of T3 used to treat more acute hypothyroid disorders.
Both products are marketed under approved New Drug Applications, it added.
"The addition of two strategic sole source products to our growing endocrine sales focus is very exciting," Dennis Jones, chairman, said in a statement.
Jones Medical is a specialty pharmaceutical company.
